name: truncate
covering_tests: "Strings" category methods :: `_.truncate` should return an empty string for empty values
lodash methods :: should accept falsey arguments
lodash(...) methods that return unwrapped values :: `_(...).truncate` should return an unwrapped value when implicitly chaining
lodash.truncate :: should coerce `length` to an integer
lodash.truncate :: should coerce `string` to a string
lodash.truncate :: should coerce nullish `omission` values to strings
lodash.truncate :: should not truncate if `string` is <= `length`
lodash.truncate :: should truncate string the given length
lodash.truncate :: should use a default `length` of `30`
lodash.truncate :: should work as an iteratee for methods like `_.map`
uncommon symbols :: should account for astral symbols
